name: quiz-world
description: Real-time buzzer quiz tournament platform for hosts and participants

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up
scripts.db:tables: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=local AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=local aws dynamodb list-tables --endpoint-url http://localhost:8000 --region ap-northeast-1
scripts.db:scan: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=local AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=local aws dynamodb scan --table-name quiz-world-tournaments --endpoint-url http://localhost:8000 --region ap-northeast-1 --output table
scripts.db:admin: DYNAMO_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:8000 AWS_REGION=ap-northeast-1 AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=local AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=local npx --yes dynamodb-admin
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:run
